title: Chanakya
desc: Arjun, a highly sought-after RAW agent, is known for his skills at catching some of the most hardened criminals. However, he falls in danger when he goes after Ibrahim Qureshi, a terrorist.

title: Thaye Bhuvaneshwari
desc: Prema, an ardent devotee of Goddess Soundarya, encounters an evil man, who forces her into submission. However, her belief in the Almighty stands unwavered.

title: Thalattu Padava
desc: Raja, an educated young man, works as a driver for a rich client and gets harassed by his granddaughter. When she realises how learned he is, she falls in love with him and wishes to marry him.

title: Sathuran
desc: Dheena, an auto-rickshaw driver, unknowingly takes two hitmen as passengers. Thereafter, his life changes as he becomes a suspect in a case involving medical malpractice.

title: Chinna
desc: Chinna, a gangster, changes his way of life after he falls in love with Gayatri. However, he ends up in jail after he kills a gang leader in order to save Gayatri.
